claim: A whole hidden ROM does not remove a delayed DivMMC RST 38 trap; clear only its enabling bit and keep the other DivMMC controls.

evidence.text: A whole hidden ROM does not remove a delayed DivMMC RST 38 trap; clear only its enabling bit and keep the other controls.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite XD3): with an alt ROM image replacing the ROM, a delayed RST $38 trap still mapped DivMMC.
